changes.description: [Bug Fix] Fixed incorrect mapping of on action. [Issue#539](https://github.com/yarafie/awesome-ha-blueprints/issues/539). Reported by [@DuffyTheDisneyBear](https://github.com/DuffyTheDisneyBear).

changes.author: @yarafie
changes.description: [Bug Fix] The blueprint now matches the remote, which has a single wheel and no Up/Down buttons. The inputs are now Wheel single press, Wheel double press, Wheel triple press and Rotate wheel. The remote alternates between `on` and `off` for single presses, both now count as a single press, and what Zigbee2MQTT reports as `off_double` is a triple press. After updating you need to set up your custom actions again, and update the Light, Media Player and Cover hooks to version 2026.11.22 or newer. This will close ([issue#539](https://github.com/yarafie/awesome-ha-blueprints/issues/539)). Reported by [@DuffyTheDisneyBear](https://github.com/DuffyTheDisneyBear). ([@yarafie](https://github.com/yarafie))
